episodes.name: The Book of Occupation: Chapter One: Birth of Blackbird
episodes.overview: We find Jefferson Pierce like never before, in the hands of the ASA with his wife Lynn as Agent Odell tightens his grip on the Pierce family, leaving Jennifer abandoned and Freeland without Black Lightning and Thunder. But Anissa secretly defies Odell in her alter ego as Blackbird with the able tactical and technical support of Gambi.

episodes.name: The Book of Occupation: Chapter Two: Maryam's Tasbih
episodes.overview: With Freeland under full-blown occupation, the Pierce family gets pulled in different directions. Jefferson and Lynn find themselves at odds with each other. Meanwhile, Anissa rebels as Blackbird while Jennifer feels powerless despite having powers.

episodes.name: The Book of Occupation: Chapter Three: Agent Odell's Pipe-Dream
episodes.overview: When Lynn learns that Jefferson brokered a deal with Agent Odell without consulting her first, it begins to put a strain on their relationship. Meanwhile, Anissa and Grace have an emotional encounter.

episodes.name: The Book of Occupation: Chapter Four: Lynn's Ouroboros
episodes.overview: Jefferson faces new challenges due to the shocking state of Freeland; Lynn finds herself under intense pressure as she desperately tries to find a solution to the continuing crisis in Freeland; Anissa continues her work at the clinic.

episodes.name: The Book of Occupation: Chapter Five: Requiem for Tavon
episodes.overview: Jefferson struggles with the effects on his family, leading to a decision with tragic consequences. Meanwhile, Anissa's identity is threatened. Lastly, Agent Odell takes an important step toward winning over Jennifer.

episodes.name: The Book of Resistance: Chapter One: Knocking on Heaven's Door
episodes.overview: Jefferson, is torn between his loyalty to his family and his commitment to saving Freeland. Meanwhile, Anissa's commitment to Grace is deepening. Lastly, Jennifer makes an interesting discovery.

episodes.name: The Book of Resistance: Chapter Two: Henderson's Opus
episodes.overview: Anissa and Jefferson have a heart-to-heart and she tells him she needs Black Lightning’s help in escorting meta refugees out of the perimeter. Meanwhile, Gambi  implores Lynn to help get him access to the Pit. Lastly, Jennifer  grows closer to Brandon.

episodes.name: The Book of Resistance: Chapter Three: The Battle of Franklin Terrace
episodes.overview: Black Lightning decides to fight back when the ASA threatens his old neighborhood. Thunder battles Painkiller, and Tobias has a plan for Lynn to stop the ASA from weaponizing the metas.

episodes.name: The Book of Resistance: Chapter Four: Earth Crisis
episodes.overview: With the coming of the red skies, Jennifer finds herself torn between worlds.

episodes.name: The Book of Markovia: Chapter One: Blessings and Curses Reborn
episodes.overview: Jefferson navigates his new reality following the events of the Crisis, and Lynn’s determination to save the meta kids deepens her troubles. Meanwhile, Anissa/Blackbird faces new challenges. Lastly, Jennifer’s bond with Brandon begins to grow.

episodes.name: The Book of Markovia: Chapter Two: Lynn's Addiction
episodes.overview: Jefferson, Anissa and Jennifer discover that the ASA is now hunting the entire Pierce family. Meanwhile, Lynn  does the unthinkable.

episodes.name: The Book of Markovia: Chapter Three: Motherless ID
episodes.overview: Jefferson and Anissa join forces with the ASA to help one of their own. Meanwhile, Lynn is forced to continue battling her demons.

episodes.name: The Book of Markovia: Chapter Four: Grab the Strap
episodes.overview: Black Lightning and his team descend upon Markovia on a mission to rescue Lynn who finds herself in even more trouble when she meets Gravedigger, a metahuman on the Markovian side.

episodes.name: The Book of War: Chapter One: Homecoming
episodes.overview: As the battle continues, old alliances are revisited and new alliances forged.

episodes.name: The Book of War: Chapter Two: Freedom Ain't Free
episodes.overview: After learning that Gravedigger and the Markovians are coming to attack Freeland, the Pierce family prepares for war.

episodes.name: The Book of War: Chapter Three: Liberation
episodes.overview: Black Lightning faces off against Gravedigger.
